summary: This memo is an official ICCB and DARPA policy statement on rolling out the Exterior Gateway Protocol. After 1 August 1984 every gateway had to belong to an autonomous system, and some gateway of each system had to exchange routing information with the core using EGP.

eli5.summary: The bosses of the network announced a deadline: after a set date, every router must join a team and talk to the main team using one shared language.
